name: Code Review Pack
description: A skill and two quick actions for careful code reviews.

skills.title: Review checklist
skills.description: What to check before approving a change

quickActions.title: Review my diff
quickActions.prompt: Review the current diff. Follow the review checklist skill. Report findings ordered by severity, with file and line.

quickActions.title: Explain this change
quickActions.prompt: Explain what the current diff changes and why, in plain language, for a teammate who has not seen the code.
